STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast/brunch tray: a latte-style coffee, toasted multigrain bread with avocado, a small bowl of mandarin orange segments, and a cup of Greek-style yogurt. The tray is in a seat-back setting (likely an airline meal), so the photo is not a single plated dish.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The main vessel is a white disposable paper plate, about 20 cm in diameter (area ≈ 314 cm²). The mandarin bowl is a small dish, about 8–10 cm (area ≈ 60 cm²). The coffee is in a mug (not food). The yogurt cup is about 7 cm across, treated as a separate item.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Two slices of multigrain/seeded toast (bread)
- Sliced avocado
- Mandarin orange segments
- Greek-style yogurt (plain)
- Latte (milk-based coffee drink, counted as an item but with little food weight)

STEP 4 - Area (of the plate, 314 cm²):
- Bread (two slices, overlapping): ~30% ≈ 94 cm²
- Avocado: ~8% ≈ 25 cm²
- Mandarin bowl (separate vessel, not on plate): excluded from plate percentages.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Bread: 94 cm² × 1.6 cm (two stacked slices) ≈ 150 ml
- Avocado: 25 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 38 ml
- Mandarin: bowl ~60 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 40 ml of pieces, at partial fill ≈ 30 ml
- Yogurt: a standard ~150 g cup, taken directly as ~150 g

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Bread: 150 ml × 0.9 ≈ 135 g (two slices of bread is realistically ~70–80 g; using the bread-slice density on the outer envelope overestimates, so take ≈ 75 g)
- Avocado: 38 ml × 0.9 ≈ 35 g (about 1/4 avocado)
- Mandarin segments: 30 ml × 0.6 ≈ 20 g
- Yogurt: ~150 g
- Latte: ~200 g of milk-based drink (whole-milk latte, mostly milk)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Bread (multigrain): 75 g × 250 kcal/100 g ≈ 188 kcal
- Avocado: 35 g × 160 kcal/100 g ≈ 56 kcal
- Mandarin: 20 g × 47 kcal/100 g ≈ 9 kcal
- Greek yogurt (plain, whole): 150 g × 100 kcal/100 g ≈ 150 kcal
- Latte (whole milk): 200 g × 50 kcal/100 g ≈ 100 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total food (excluding the latte) ≈ 75 + 35 + 20 + 150 ≈ 280 g, and about 400 kcal. That is plausible for a breakfast tray with two slices of toast, a quarter avocado, a small fruit portion, and a yogurt. Including the latte, the tray is about 480 g and roughly 500 kcal.
